title: Schöfferstraße, Darmstadt
description:
LIVE FULLY – Student Housing. Just better.

Welcome to our student residence in Darmstadt! Find your second home in Germany's most future-oriented city! A complete package awaits you, which will make your student days unforgettable:

Choose your dream apartment from 342 fully furnished single and double studios with their own pantry kitchen and shower room. With us you will find the perfect combination between your own living space and a great community. Get to know your roommates in the spacious living room with a movie corner. Have a barbecue together in the green inner courtyard or relax on the spacious roof terrace. The best way to get to know culinary delights from all over the world is to cook in the communal kitchen. Do you need peace and quiet while studying? Put concentrated sessions in the study room and exchange ideas with others. You will meet our house managers, who are always ready to listen to you, at the reception.

Highlight: Never miss a lecture again: Your apartment is in the middle of the university campus!
Take a look at our 3D tour and get a first impression of what your life with us could look like.

YOUR HIGHLIGHTS
•	All-in rent (including electricity, heating and water costs and internet at a monthly flat rate)
•	Common areas: Movie lounge, study rooms, roof terrace, courtyard, community kitchen, gaming area, reception, laundry and drying rooms
•	Bicycle cellar: Park your bike safely in the lockable bicycle cellar
•	Underground car park: Your car is also safe in our underground car park.
•	Parcel acceptance during opening hours at the reception
•	Free rental of household appliances (vacuum cleaner, iron, etc.)
•	Exclusive partner deals: save outside at selected locations with your Member Card
•	Regular events and activities
•	A community that gives you the opportunity to make friends out of neighbours

YOUR FULLY FURNISHED APARTMENT
Your bright apartment offers a living room with bed including mattress, desk with chair, cloakroom with mirror, light-proof curtains, intercom and generally extra storage space. The pantry kitchen is equipped with two ceramic hobs, a combination microwave, fridge with freezer, a sink and counter. The modern tiled shower room has a toilet, a vanity with a mirror and additional storage space.

All services and ancillary costs such as heating and hot water as well as internet are included in the rent. You can not only choose the size and location of your apartment, but also between single or double apartments.

* The photos shown are sample images.
** Our single studios are available in different sizes and prices. Please visit our website for more information.

DIRECTLY OPPOSITE THE UNIVERSITY OF DARMSTADT
Your new apartment in Darmstadt is located in the middle of the university campus! In the nearby Martinsviertel, students meet in the coolest bars in town. Drug stores and supermarkets, restaurants, parks and fitness studios are in the immediate vicinity! There is also a good connection with public transport, so you can be in the city centre in no time at all. You can walk to the main train station within a few minutes.

YOUR ALL-IN PRICE

In our community,  you get a complete living concept and not just an apartment! Your all-in price includes the following services:
Apartment services

•	Apartment
•	Furniture
•	Utilities (water, electricity)
•	Internet

Living Services

•	Reception/House Management/House Technician
•	Rental items (vacuum cleaner, iron, games, etc.)
•	Parcel acceptance
•	Common rooms
•	Events

Tip: Benefit from the best offer: The earlier you book and the longer you stay, the better the price offer will be.

SIMPLY PULL IN AND FEEL COMFORTABLE
Our house managers will take care of your concerns from the moment you move in and, for example, receive your parcels or provide you with free loan equipment (such as vacuum cleaners or irons). A central main entrance, to which you only get access through a chip, as well as the video surveillance of all entrances and exits ensure additional security.

💡NOTE:
•  Admission fee:
         ** 6-9 Month = 249€
         **10 Month and more = 99€
•  The deposit is 3x the monthly cold rent.

 **Please note that the rent written on the listing is (hidden) rent. There is a surcharge for quieter apartments facing the courtyard or for apartments on a higher floor level. Deposit may change depending on your chosen rental period or features of your preferred apartment. If you are interested, do let us know and we will send you the offer!
